hook: You've reprompted the same AI message 6 times and it still sounds like a LinkedIn post from 2019.
caption:
You've reprompted the same AI message 6 times and it still sounds like a LinkedIn post from 2019.

Here's what's actually happening:

AI doesn't know if you're the person who writes in short punchy sentences. Or the one who needs three examples before an idea clicks. Or the one who hates bullet points because they flatten your thinking.

So it guesses. And it guesses… corporate. Safe. Beige.

The fix isn't a better prompt. It's context that travels with you.

When AI knows you default to first-principles reasoning, it stops explaining basics you already know.

When it knows you communicate like you're texting a smart friend, it stops writing press releases.

When it knows you need the "why" before the "how," it leads with that — every time.

That's what a BootFile does. It's a profile of how you actually think, built once, used everywhere. No more re-explaining yourself. No more reprompting into oblivion.

The AI doesn't get smarter. It just finally knows who it's talking to.
